interpretation: An insufficient_library decision is a completed negative scientific result. Transition-limit exhaustion is recorded as incomplete and carries no adequacy conclusion.

The exhaustive audit independently simulates packets and constructs abstraction keys before comparing producer, standalone checker, and numeric evaluator on every admitted coloring, valid service word, and ambient cut subset of each retained micro-model.

The three full reproductions compare decisions, cuts, witnesses, certificates, oracle results, audit results, and tables while excluding only run-dependent timing, memory, resume, and per-invocation counters.
The final clean runs use no paper files for science, network access, package installation, solver, GPU, model API, private cache, or external input.

The paper build validates bibliographic metadata against the retained audit and checks compilation, page count, letter size, encryption, references, overfull boxes, and font embedding. External publisher metadata remains subject to human author review before submission.
The paper build fixes SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH to the research-freeze date; the packaged main and supplement PDFs matched both consecutive clean builds byte for byte.
The reference preflight locks all four first-party USENIX URLs exactly; a deliberate wrong-path mutation for FPerf is rejected before TeX compilation.

The retained fixed-schedule cross-interpreter audit compares all 51 cases and requires equality of 35,216 producer/checker event records as multisets and 107,400 independently built query-coefficient cells.

The closest-source calibration record was completed after re-opening all 19 PDF pages of Count-Buffy: its bibliography ends at reference [30], and the manuscript still uses its own relevance-first 30-entry cited bibliography rather than padding to imitate that count.
